exploit_name: Missing deadline parameter in register signatures
description: The signed message omits a deadline timestamp, allowing operator signatures to remain valid indefinitely.
attack_scenario: Operator signs authorization for agent registration. Even after unbonding and retrieving deposits, a service owner can reuse the signature to force re-registration, triggering bond transfers from the operator's account.
root_cause: The signed message omits a deadline timestamp, allowing operator signatures to remain valid indefinitely.
fix_description: Include a deadline parameter in the signed message. Enforce the deadline hasn't passed during execution.
notes: Operators cannot revoke consent without nonce changes. Unintended token lockups occur via reused signatures.
